(WebFetch extraction 22 Nov 2026 ~08:00 GMT — curl returned 403; Times of Israel / AFP reporting, published 22 Nov 2026 01:01 GMT)

Bahrain said an Iranian attack hit a civilian industrial facility, causing a fire but no injuries. Residents reported smoke over Sitra Island, which has several industrial sites, including a Bapco refinery. Bahrain's Defense Force said its air defenses intercepted several Iranian aerial attacks; shrapnel caused material damage but no casualties.
The Revolutionary Guards said they launched a combined missile and drone attack on US positions at the Al-Riffa and Awali bases in Bahrain, describing it as retaliation for "ongoing aggression" against Iran.
US Central Command had not commented on the Guards' claim at publication.
The attacks came after tankers were struck while exiting the Strait of Hormuz, and Iran's army said a ship hit a mine there. Major combat largely stopped after an April ceasefire; indirect talks on a broader agreement are ongoing.
